test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A professor __begins__ class by holding up a glass of water.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**' i.e. **began**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense**, as it is describing an action that has already happened.
 
• The correct past tense form of the verb "**begin**" is "**began**."
 
• Options 2 ("beginning"), 3 ("is began"), and 4 ("was begins") are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *A professor **began**__ class by holding up a glass of water.*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "beginning"** is incorrect because it is in the present participle form, which does not fit the past tense context.
 
• **Option 3: "is began"** is incorrect because "is" and "began" cannot be used together as they mix present and past tenses.
 
• **Option 4: "was begins"** is incorrect because "was" is past tense, while "begins" is present tense.
